en.hubeali: H 14821 – Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al-Nahdy, from Muawiya Bin Hukeym, from one of his men, from Anbasat Bin Bajaad, who has narrated: Abu Abdullahasws

regarding the Statement of Allahazwj: “[56:90] And if he is of those on the right hand, [56:91] Then the greeting from those on the right hand”, so heasws said: ‘The Rasool Allahsaww said to Aliasws: ‘These are yourasws Shites from whom yourasws children would be safe from being killed’.
en.sarwar: 374. Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad Al-Nahdy, from Muawiya Bin Hukeym, from one of his men, from Anbasat Bin Bajaad, who has narrated:

Abu Abdullah (a.s.) regarding the Statement of Allah (azwj): “[56:90] And if he is of those on the right hand, [56:91] Then the greeting from those on the right hand”, so he (a.s.) said: ‘The Rasool Allah (saww) said to Ali (a.s.): ‘These are your (a.s.) Shites from whom your (a.s.) children would be safe from being killed’.
